messages:
ada: Quick heads-up 1: prototyping a console card that breaks down token spend by 'token-path' (route -> router decision -> final SKU -> prefetch/cache delta). Looking for opinions on telemetry shape, sampling defaults, and export needs.

james: Nice. Are we planning per-invocation fidelity or sampled aggregates? Per-invocation is exact but heavy on ingest and storage.

ada: Proposal: full fidelity for very recent windows (last 5m and 1h rollups), rollups + reservoir sampling for 24h+, and coarse daily aggregates beyond that. Keeps drilldowns responsive while bounding cost.

nina: UX notes: show a route-level sparkline, then expand to a stacked bar: direct token spend vs apportioned cache savings. Click into a bar to see top token-paths with qpath_id, sample rate, and median latency.

ryan: Router must emit a lineage_ref on every request so we can attribute the final_sku even after fallbacks. Today fallback swaps break cache crediting and the dashboard jumps.

james: Implementation: emit compact event with qpath_id (64-bit hash), route, tokens_in, cache_hit(bool), final_sku (nullable). Materialize full lineage docs asynchronously keyed by qpath_id to avoid inflating per-event size.

ada: Telemetry contract draft: qpath_id (required), tokens_in (required), tokens_out, route, router_version, routing_policy, final_sku, fallback_reason, cache_hit, prefetch_matches. Make non-critical fields optional.

finance-bot: finance: Need an admin CSV export for chargeback: columns = qpath_id, credited_sku, apportioned_cost_usd, credited_cost_usd, sample_method, confidence_interval. Export must be filterable by time range and routes.

nina: UX decision: default external-facing view = "credited owner" (single owner) to avoid customer confusion. Internal default = "apportioned". Add a tooltip explaining the math and a link to docs.

ryan: Also surface per-route quota usage (burst_limit, used_in_window) in the same panel so we can correlate quota-driven reroutes with cost spikes.

james: One caveat: adding qpath_id increases cardinality. Use hashed 64-bit id and low-cardinality index path. Offer redaction for public logs.

ada: Simulation widget idea: slider to shift X% traffic between SKUs and project delta in monthly token spend and cache-hit change. Base on recent 7d sample and show uncertainty bands from sample variance.

finance-bot: finance: Also request that CSV includes both apportioned and credited columns so reconciliation can pick the preferred method; include source_note describing sampling windows.

nina: UI copy: show a small confidence badge when numbers are sampled and a help modal describing apportioned vs credited. Internal users can toggle 'show apportioned' by default.

james: I'll open telemetry PR to add qpath_id emission and a lightweight lineage store. Ops, can we stage schema as "tokenpath-lineage-v1" to a canary cluster?

ada: Will file a short RFC with wireframes, telemetry contract, export API spec POST /internal/exports/tokenpaths, and simulation math. If anyone strongly objects to apportioned-default internal, say now.

ryan: +1 apportioned for internal.

nina: +1

james: +1

ada: Thanks all, filing RFC.
